notes.title: Dreamland Prison is coming to Kickstarter alongside with free demo
notes.content:
[url=www.kickstarter.com/projects/laughingfoxgames/dreamland-prison][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485689/60f1ee1d9ff2babf670921f60bc2b07a47a09ebe.png[/img][/url]

We are now available for you on [url=www.kickstarter.com/projects/laughingfoxgames/dreamland-prison]Kickstarter[/url]! You can support us by clicking "Notify me on launch", which will help in the success of our campaign!

[url=www.kickstarter.com/projects/laughingfoxgames/dreamland-prison][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485689/b47fe9f5437c26a644669c0306168181b2151095.gif[/img][/url]

The demo version of Dreamland Prison will be available soon, which we are extremely proud of! The opportunity to share the fruit of our work with you is a fantastic experience and makes us want to create fantastic world of Ezares for you!

We are starting the Kickstarter campaign in just a few days! Dear players, we count on your support in developing the game and our passion! We will make every effort to ensure that the delivered adventure is complete, interesting, and above all - it will provide you with unforgettable entertainment for dozens of hours!
